notes.title: Version 0.978Update Notice
Emergency Fix: Attribute Reset Bug
notes.notes:
In the version updated two hours ago, a bug occurred due to the addition of a new feature — all character attributes reset to level 1 upon entering the Sacrifice interface.

If your save file was rendered unusable due to this, we deeply apologize and will learn from this mistake. In the future, we will ensure thorough testing before releasing updates.

The bug has now been fixed. We apologize again for any inconvenience caused.

2. Fix the issue where enemies do not fully recover health after entering battle.
3. Increase the spawn rate of enemies in trials.
4. Added a button for automatically dismantling low-level equipment in offline mode.

notes.title: Version 0.976Update Notice

2. Double the spawn rate of offline enemies.
3. Fix the issue where enemies in offline mode cannot be killed (all enemies will be cleared every 30 minutes).

notes.title: Version 0.95Update Notice
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug where the game pauses when minimized during idle. Now you can safely run it in the background!
2. Fixed the bug where talent points were still deducted for reactivating talents.
3. Followers can now be sorted by level! Sacrifices are in descending order, others in ascending order.
4. Materials can now be stacked to display quantities!

notes.title: Version 0.94Update Notice
Version 0.93Update Notice
notes.notes:
1. Fixed the bug where talents were lost after loading a save file.
2. Fixed the low frame rate issue, significantly reducing stuttering and increasing frame rates.
3. Lowered the strength increase of enemies, making their upgrades smoother.
4. Fixed a series of bugs causing game freezes.
 
 
We are a two-person indie game development team. Due to our lack of experience, there are many immature designs and bugs. We apologize for the poor experience this may have caused. You can provide feedback on your needs, and we will fix it as soon as possible! Thank you for purchasing our game! Thank you!

notes.title: Version 0.92 Emergency Bug Fix
High Freedom/Idle Mode/Rogue-like Auto Chess "ElderGods Simulator" is released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are the developers of "ElderGods Simulator." You might not have heard of this game because we haven't done any promotions. Here, I want to tell you, this game is really worth buying!
Because:
1. Its characters and equipment are randomly generated, each game is a new experience!
2. It allows you to set up teammate positions with visual programming tools, creating a unique legion!
3. It has an idle mode, so you can farm gear in the background while slacking off at work. Trust me, your boss will hate this game!
4. You can upload your own images as character portraits. You can upload your friends, colleagues, family, and classmates, making it easy to create a family party!
5. It's very cheap, probably the cheapest in its category! We also have frequent discounts!

If you have any opinions and ideas, please let us know. We look forward to your feedback~

notes.title: Rogue-like Treasure Farming "ElderGods Simulator" New Demo Release for Fest!
notes.notes:
"ElderGods Simulator" is an auto chess + idle + light Rogue game where players take on the role of an ancient evil god awakening from darkness. 
By recruiting followers and captives, and upgrading seals, you enhance your power. All followers and enemies are randomly generated, and any extraordinary material can be freely combined with a seal to enhance its abilities, allowing you to create unique skills and armies.
